title: Give your image versions
summary: Build version 1.0, change the app, build 2.0, point latest at it, and keep 1.0 running.

tasks.title: `greet-tags:1.0` is built from the code as it is now (it says Hello)
`greet-tags:2.0` is built after changing `Hello` to `Welcome` in `app.js`
tasks.hint:
In `app.js`, find `

Hello, ${name}! 👋

` and change `Hello` to `Welcome`. Save, then `docker build -t greet-tags:2.0 .`

tasks.title: `greet-tags:latest` is the same image as `2.0`
tasks.hint: A tag is a name on an image. Put a second name on 2.0: `docker tag greet-tags:2.0 greet-tags:latest`. `docker images greet-tags` shows the same IMAGE ID for both.

tasks.title: `v1` runs `greet-tags:1.0` on `http://localhost:3403`, still saying Hello
tasks.hint: `docker run -d --name v1 -p 3403:3000 greet-tags:1.0`. The old version is still there, untouched by your change.
